summary: P523 preparation rerun on the current tree for WI-10004144: the same 42 papercusp-desktop native Node test files as rerun4 all passed: 564 tests, 564 pass, 0 fail, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled, 0 todo, exit 0. Bindings 16308/16309 went source-stale only because papercusp-desktop/package.json moved (desktop b559ef01, which adds test/vm-rig-probe-session.test.js to the test:shell list). Temporary fixture repos and artifacts with mocked transports. Preparation only: this is not a full installer build, signing, notarization or P-521 acceptance.

assertions.evidence: The run wrote EXIT=0. The TAP output ended with tests 564, pass 564, fail 0, cancelled 0, skipped 0, todo 0, duration_ms 136927.43432. Counting TAP lines gave 564 'ok' and 0 'not ok'.

Before and after the run, the snapshot recorded both repo heads, the papercusp-desktop dirty count, the papercusp-desktop/package.json SHA-256 (96572092ffb83417452c175804e60e3e75b1817104cea9060b0711d990646b99), and a SHA-256 digest of the 42 test files plus papercusp-desktop/bin/*.sh and bin/*.mjs (b6bdfe074e9561b5b55124c4cc0d7760de03c8c3fea14e60e6234e7244c51306). All were identical before and after: superproject ffd3a468ad, desktop 1e1101e24e, dirty count 3. The three dirty desktop files (bin/hive-git-drill.sh, bin/lib/physical-failure-summary.sh, bin/vm-rig/same-box-rig.sh) are not in any P-523 binding's measured sources, and none of the 42 test files references them (grep).
194 of the 564 passing tests have refusal-shaped names (case-insensitive regex refus|reject|fail|corrupt|absent|invalid|missing|denies|block). This is a name-based count, not a mutation proof.
TAP ok 363 - a reused manifest receipt re-verifies its outputs instead of publishing on trust. TAP ok 364 - a reused manifest receipt refuses outputs it did not commit.
TAP ok 48 - refuses to publish a deb when its updater signature is missing. TAP ok 49 - refuses to publish either final path when the staged signature is invalid.

TAP ok 72 - loads the conventional mode-0600 updater key when no signing env is supplied. TAP ok 73 - honors TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH instead of the conventional path. TAP ok 76 - signing-key preflight runs before seed staging and the expensive build.

TAP ok 68 - FAILS when db-sql/ has zero migration files. TAP ok 182 - compatibility requires extraction, intact bytes, and corruption refusal. TAP ok 188 - a passing installed update writes a tag-scoped receipt bound to provenance bytes. TAP ok 190 - Windows refuses a provenance-listed Server span when any disk is absent. TAP ok 211 - macOS refuses a GUI-only transition when the matching Server DMG is absent.

TAP ok 152 - the sidecar provenance receives the immutable build SHA and version. TAP ok 153 - vm-release sidecar reuse rejects provenance that differs from the launcher build SHA. TAP ok 245 - verify-provenance gates build-start dirt, not later cutter mutations. TAP ok 246 - verify-provenance rejects missing or non-boolean gitDirty attestations. TAP ok 247 - verify-provenance rejects missing or malformed release identity.
